column1: What are laptop policies for purchases
column2:
The policies related to laptop purchase are as follows:

- Standard issue laptops are available to order in Oracle Procurement Cloud.
- For non-standard laptops, a detailed justification is required explaining the feature and functionality differences compared to approved standards.
- Employees are eligible for one desktop or laptop and may refresh the device every three years for Windows devices and every four years for Apple devices.
- A hardware purchase check is performed to ensure compliance with corporate guidelines.
- For new hires, standard issue laptops should be ordered in Oracle Procurement Cloud; non-standard laptops for new hires should use the Laptop-New Hire category.
- Include the supplier quote number in the item description and attach a detailed justification for non-standard laptop purchases.
- One quote is required for purchases above $5,000.
- Procurement review is always required for laptop purchases.
- A contract is required for transactions of $100,000 or more; refer to the Master Purchase and Services Agreement (MPSA) for details.
- Work with designated Procurement Contacts (e.g., Amy Agenta, Elena Ellsworth, Teresa May) for assistance.
- Purchase requisitions should include a detailed description of the laptop (model and part number) and attach the supplier quote.
These policies ensure employees have necessary equipment while adhering to corporate procurement procedures.

column1: What if I need to order a non-standard laptop
column2:
If you need to order a non-standard laptop, the policy requires you to provide a detailed justification explaining the feature and functionality differences compared to the approved standard laptops. For new hires, non-standard laptops should be ordered using the Laptop-New Hire category in Oracle Procurement Cloud.

Additionally, you must include the supplier quote number in the item description and attach the detailed justification for the non-standard laptop purchase. Procurement review is always required for this category, and one quote is required for purchases above $5,000.

It is recommended to work with the designated Procurement Contacts for assistance with the purchase. This process ensures compliance with corporate guidelines while addressing specific equipment needs.
